scenario: A series declaring `median, p95 sliding 10_min` (LSER.16.4.1: `pXX` for any integer percentile in 1..99), with no accuracy phrase, and a rule reading the `p95` companion slot (LSER.6.1) compiles. PINS ONLY THAT IT COMPILES: no value is read. Named for the LSER.16.4 heading (quantiles).
rules_ds:
use default

schema Sensor scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    state: Float mutable

series Sensor.state:
    median, p95 sliding 10_min

rule r:
    Sensor s where s.p95 > 50.0
->
    log critical "{s.entity_id}"
